{{Quote|I was going to use fresh bantha manure, but then I decided on Banthamax 4600-SL synthetic bantha manure with exceptional fertilizing power and realistic manure smell.|[[Zorajas Garamin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 2|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Banthamax 4600-SL''' was a brand of [[Fertilizer/Legends|fertilizer]] used by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a synthetic [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] manure with exceptional fertilizing power and realistic manure smell. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] farmer [[Zorajas Garamin]] used Banthamax 4600-SL in his [[Zorajas Garamin's farm|farm]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" />
